description: This file defines the GetBucketLocationParser class, which extends an abstract parser to specifically handle the GetBucketLocation operation in the AWS S3 service. It decorates another parser to add custom logic for extracting the bucket location from the response.

classes.name: GetBucketLocationParser
classes.description: A parser class that handles the GetBucketLocation operation for AWS S3, decorating another parser to add specific logic for extracting the location constraint from the response.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the parser by wrapping another parser object.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the response, checks if the command is GetBucketLocation, and extracts the location constraint from the response body.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a member from a stream to the wrapped parser.
